description: React component for rendering a virtualized tree structure with drag-and-drop support, including folder and item management, search filtering, and editing capabilities.

classes.name: DragPlaceholder
classes.description: Invisible placeholder component for maintaining droppable area during drag operations.

classes.name: TreeItemWrapper
classes.description: Memoized wrapper component for individual tree items, handling rendering and interaction.

classes.name: VirtualizedTreeItem
classes.description: Main memoized component for rendering a single item in the virtualized tree list.

methods.name: VirtualizedTreeItemComponent
methods.description: Function component that renders a tree item based on index and data, managing visibility, drag state, and interaction.
